# Day-ahead model (issue 10:00 on D-1): single test evaluation (generated by `scripts/run_dayahead.py`)

Git commit `8f5e1c83a4`. Leads 14-37 h from the 10:00 origin; scenario A, same (day, hour) samples for all models. Samples: training 19,825, validation 4,367, test 8,611. MAE in MW. Models fitted on the training period only with the validation-chosen configuration.

| model | test MAE (MW) | MAPE % |
|---|---:|---:|
| naive: same hour on the latest earlier day | 6,224 | 3.23 |
| naive: same hour last week | 8,476 | 4.41 |
| ridge (full_abs, alpha 0.1) | 4,826 | 2.54 |
| XGBoost S4 (pooled) | 4,120 | 2.15 |
| LSTM L4 (pooled) | 4,634 | 2.41 |

Run time 242 s.
